hook.say: Turkey's ten largest lakes, ranked. Number one is bigger than Luxembourg!

outro.say: Which lake have you visited? Comment below!

items.name: Lake Çıldır
items.say: Number ten: Lake Chuldir, frozen solid every winter. 115 square kilometers.
items.cap: Number ten: Lake Çıldır, frozen solid every winter. 115 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Uluabat
items.say: Nine: Lake Ooloo-abaht, home of a famous stork village. 134 square kilometers.
items.cap: Nine: Lake Uluabat, home of a famous stork village. 134 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Acıgöl
items.say: Eight: Lake Ahjuh-gurl, its name means bitter lake. 153 square kilometers.
items.cap: Eight: Lake Acıgöl, its name means bitter lake. 153 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Manyas
items.say: Seven: Lake Mahnyas, a paradise for birds. 166 square kilometers.
items.cap: Seven: Lake Manyas, a paradise for birds. 166 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Burdur
items.say: Six: Lake Boordoor, salty and shrinking fast. 200 square kilometers.
items.cap: Six: Lake Burdur, salty and shrinking fast. 200 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake İznik
items.say: Five: Lake Izneek, hiding a sunken basilica. 308 square kilometers.
items.cap: Five: Lake İznik, hiding a sunken basilica. 308 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Eğirdir
items.say: Four: Lake Eh-eerdeer, famous for changing colors. 482 square kilometers.
items.cap: Four: Lake Eğirdir, famous for changing colors. 482 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Beyşehir
items.say: Three: Lake Bay-sheheer, Turkey's largest freshwater lake. 656 square kilometers.
items.cap: Three: Lake Beyşehir, Turkey's largest freshwater lake. 656 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Tuz
items.say: Two: Lake Tooz, the salt lake that turns pink. 1500 square kilometers.
items.cap: Two: Lake Tuz, the salt lake that turns pink. 1,500 square kilometers.

items.name: Lake Van
items.say: And number one: Lake Vahn! 3755 square kilometers, bigger than Luxembourg.
items.cap: And number one: Lake Van! 3,755 square kilometers, bigger than Luxembourg.
